reponse:
Last Thursday (November 12), the ingestion service deployment (v2.14.0) raised the default `max_batch_bytes` from 1 MB to 10 MB, causing the `ingest-worker` pods (which had a 512 Mi memory limit) to run out of memory and crash-loop [1][4]. This resulted in a 3 hour and 40 minute delay (08:47 to 12:27 UTC) where customer dashboards showed stale data [1]. 

No customer data was lost; events kept arriving in Kafka and were processed late once the service was rolled back to v2.13.3 [1][4].

To prevent this from happening again, the team is implementing the following changes:
- Paging the on-call when consumer lag exceeds 5 minutes [1].
- Routing ingestion configuration changes to the canary pool first [1].
- Raising the worker memory limit to 1 Gi and adding a load test on batch sizes [1].
